plan.title: School Dashboard
plan.subtitle: Enrolment trend over years, infrastructure gaps, girls vs boys

panels.title: Total schools
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM school_enrolment_by_year

panels.title: Girls vs Boys Enrolment
panels.sql: SELECT 'Girls' AS category, SUM(Girls 2022) AS girls_2022, SUM(Girls 2023) AS girls_2023, SUM(Girls 2024) AS girls_2024 FROM school_enrolment_by_year UNION ALL SELECT 'Boys' AS category, SUM(Boys 2022) AS boys_2022, SUM(Boys 2023) AS boys_2023, SUM(Boys 2024) AS boys_2024 FROM school_enrolment_by_year

panels.title: Enrolment Trend
panels.sql: SELECT '2022' AS year, SUM(Girls 2022) AS girls_2022, SUM(Boys 2022) AS boys_2022 FROM school_enrolment_by_year UNION ALL SELECT '2023' AS year, SUM(Girls 2023) AS girls_2023, SUM(Boys 2023) AS boys_2023 FROM school_enrolment_by_year UNION ALL SELECT '2024' AS year, SUM(Girls 2024) AS girls_2024, SUM(Boys 2024) AS boys_2024 FROM school_enrolment_by_year

panels.title: Toilets functional (girls)
panels.sql: SELECT 'Toilets functional (girls)' AS category, COUNT(CASE WHEN Toilets functional (girls) = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS toilets, COUNT(CASE WHEN Drinking water = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS drinking_water, COUNT(CASE WHEN Electricity = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS electricity FROM school_infrastructure

panels.title: School Infrastructure
panels.sql: SELECT School Code, Toilets functional (girls), Drinking water, Electricity, Inspected On FROM school_infrastructure

plan.narrative: The school dashboard provides an overview of the enrolment trend over years, infrastructure gaps, and girls vs boys enrolment. The total number of schools is {{p1}}. The enrolment trend shows a steady increase in girls and boys enrolment over the years. The infrastructure gaps indicate that there are issues with toilets functional (girls), drinking water, and electricity in some schools. The girls vs boys enrolment chart shows that the number of girls enrolled is higher than the number of boys enrolled in all three years.
